identity.name: Submariner
identity.one_liner: The 116610 was the Cerachrom-bezel Submariner for ten years (2010-2020) before the 41mm 126610 replaced it. The reference that defined the 2010s Submariner.

narrative.story: The 116610 ran for ten years and was sold as the Submariner Date (116610LN black, 116610LV "Hulk" green) and the no-date 114060. The Cerachrom bezel (introduced 2010) was a major upgrade from the earlier aluminum bezels — virtually scratchproof and color-stable. The 3135 caliber is the workhorse Rolex automatic of the 2000s-2010s. The 116610 was the last 40mm Submariner; the 2020 126610LN and 126610LV are 41mm with the calibre 3230. The 116610 holds value well on the secondary market because the 40mm case is now the vintage-size reference.
